question: Should Telegram expose standalone `pin` and `unpin` message-tool actions, and what gate/default plus target semantics should protect them?
rationale: The missing source surface is clear, but the feature gives agents privileged persistent chat-state mutation power through bot credentials and likely needs a new Telegram action gate plus an explicit unpin target rule.

options.title: Approve gated explicit actions
options.body: Add Telegram-owned `pin` and `unpin` actions behind an explicit gate, require clear message-target semantics, and require live Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Keep delivery pin only
options.body: Do not expose standalone pin/unpin actions yet; keep the existing delivery-pin capability for messages OpenClaw sends itself.

options.title: Request a design note first
options.body: Ask for a short design covering admin-right expectations, per-account gating, implicit unpin behavior, forum-topic semantics, and live-proof requirements before implementation.

recommendation.title: Approve gated explicit actions
recommendation.body: Add Telegram-owned `pin` and `unpin` actions behind an explicit gate, require clear message-target semantics, and require live Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their feature history covers the Telegram message-tool discovery and action-runtime boundary that would need the approved contract.
